title: Choose the homepage composition
question: The visual direction is fixed. Choose the composition to carry into the responsive implementation, or describe a revision.

options.label: A · Sculptural editorial
options.thesis: An exploded inspection object and a large editorial title form a diagonal composition.
options.viewport: Role at the top, large title lower left, inspection object above and beside it.
options.risk: The hero gives more space to atmosphere before the main message.

options.label: B · Layered monograph
options.thesis: The message leads at an unmistakable scale, followed by a close inspection of the system's layers.
options.viewport: Oversized headline across the top, concise QA introduction below, wide sculpture on the right.
options.risk: The large headline needs careful mobile typography and a deliberate art crop.

options.label: C · Inspection gallery
options.thesis: A tall inspection sculpture anchors a clear and measured gallery-like introduction.
options.viewport: Left-aligned QA introduction, tall central-right sculpture, selected work directly below.
options.risk: Its left-copy/right-object structure is the most familiar of the three.
